newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly higher in livelier trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly higher in livelier trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly higher in livelier trade on Tuesday, with blue chips taking the spotlight with new gains on increased volumes.
* Volume almost tripled to 11,142 shares, while turnover more than doubled to 6.7 million kuna.
* Of 13 active issues six were up, two down and five flat.
* Top gainer Zagrebacka Banka rose 50 kuna 1,850 on 1,900 shares.
* The most actively traded issue, drug firm Pliva, rose 10.5 kuna to 450.5 on volume of 3,654 units.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Riviera Porec lost nine kuna to 145 on volume of 110 shares.
